artworks.label: Chestnut saddle
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for saddlewood. One exquisite miniature English riding saddle made from richly grained chestnut leather, fine cream stitching, softly padded sage suede seat, small warm brass fittings, standing on a simple low pale-oak support. Premium equestrian still-life craft photography, natural leather patina and tactile wood grain, soft countryside light, chestnut/sage/cream/brass palette. No horse, stirrup, ribbon rosette, compass, clock or writing. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
